Detector API for low-contrast accepts only the wildcard '*' as an ignore value — per-pair value strings are rejected (verified via 'npx impeccable ignores add-value low-contrast'). The specific pair this ignore existed for was --accent-2 text on --accent-soft background. That pair NO LONGER EXISTS: the console was rebuilt on the Chart Tray surface system (FD-030, 2026-09-08), --accent-soft was deleted as an unused token, and --accent-2 now appears only as a solid primary-button hover fill carrying --accent-ink at 8.65:1. This ignore is therefore moot and should be removed at the next detector run that confirms no admin low-contrast finding. The detector does not account for the 6% alpha teal overlay on --bg. Contrast for this pair has been manually verified against WCAG AA in both light and dark modes. Re-review required if any other admin low-contrast finding surfaces — the value is '*' but the scope is one known pair.
